subject: Acme: deletion request — prompts / outputs / logs purge process
messages:
From: Sarah Gomez <sarah.gomez@acme.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-security@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-05-12T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Purge of prompts/outputs/logs (Acme account)

Hi Marcus —

Following our QBR and the renewed privacy review, legal has requested a targeted purge of all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and inference logs associated with Acme accounts tied to project ACME-9932. They want:

- Confirmation of the exact workflow you run to delete prompt text, model outputs, and token-level logs.
- Expected timeline for execution (deck + wallclock).
- Evidence that the purge ran (audit snapshot + checksums).
- Assurance that backups/snapshots are covered and any retention holds are respected.

Can you provide the end-to-end procedure and schedule? We have a signed data eradication form attached (signed by Acme legal).

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Gomez
Legal Ops | Acme Corp
attachments: acme_data_hold_form_signed.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Gomez <sarah.gomez@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Purge of prompts/outputs/logs (Acme account)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear ask and attaching the signed form. High level plan below; we can lock times once you confirm the acceptable window (we'd prefer after 11pm PDT to minimize impact):

1) Pre-checks (T-24h): verify account IDs, list affected model endpoints, capture an audit snapshot (read-only).
2) Hold check: cross-check legal hold flag; if a hold exists we need legal consent to override.
3) Purge run (T0): run targeted scripts to remove prompt text and model outputs from primary KV store and request logs. This includes removing cached prefixes and invalidating any cached embeddings tied to the account.
4) Backup sweep (T+1h): ensure nightly backups do not contain residual prompt/output artifacts for the window; run deletion on eligible backup slices per policy.
5) Verification (T+2h): produce an audit snapshot (CSV) with record counts and checksums; sign-off by CS + Security.
6) Post-run confirmation email + attach audit snapshot and runbook excerpt.

We'll attach our internal purge runbook excerpt and the audit snapshot after step 5. Can you confirm: (a) exact account IDs/teams to include, (b) any date range to scope (if not, we'll assume all historic data for the account), and (c) whether there are any pending legal holds?

I’ve looped in Neha and Evelyn on execution and Priya on legal escalation if needed.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-05-12T13:15:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Purge of prompts/outputs/logs (Acme account)

Marcus / team —

Thanks for the heads-up. Operational notes for the runbook:

- I will own the purge execution (INF-4821). Plan to run in the maintenance window on 2026-05-13 00:30–01:30 PDT.
- Steps will be scripted in the job CI; we will run a staging dry-run against a snapshot first (T-2h).
- Key checks: token-level log removal (grep + index prune), prompt table row deletes, embedding cache invalidation, and backup slice deletion where applicable.
- Risk: if the account used older embeddings stored in cold storage with longer retention, we will need explicit approval to run the backup sweep — otherwise we will provide the evidence and a recommended next step.

Attachments: audit_snapshot_20260512.csv (pre-run snapshot).

If Priya/legal confirms no additional holds, I will proceed with the dry-run and then the live purge.

Neha

Subject: Re: Request: Purge of prompts/outputs/logs (Acme account)

Hi Sarah — quick update and confirmation: we have a dry-run completed (no data mutations) and are scheduled to run the live purge on 2026-05-13 at 00:45 PDT (window 00:30–01:30).

Scope: All prompt inputs, model outputs, and token-level inference logs tied to Acme account IDs: acme-prod-01, acme-staging-01 (as requested). No other Acme accounts will be touched.

What we will deliver after completion:
- audit_snapshot_20260512.csv (pre-run counts)
- post_run_audit_20260513.csv (post-run counts + checksums)
- redwood_purge_runbook_v2.pdf (excerpts applied)
- ticket link (INF-4821) and hubspot deal ACME-9932 record snapshot

Notes & exceptions:
- Cold backups: we identified a legacy cold-storage slice that may still contain embeddings older than 2023. We will not automatically delete those without written confirmation from Acme Legal. If you want them removed now, please confirm in your reply and we will include them in a separate scheduled job.

Please reply with a one-line confirmation to proceed (or provide the hold override from legal). Once we get that, Neha will run the job and I will send the signed post-run audit.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin | Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
